name: celldex
role: Retrieve reference expression profiles and cell labels
coverage_note: Separate reference-data retrieval software; SingleR does not implement celldex. Exact permitted source, historical data snapshots and runtime require separate integration.

name: SPOTlight
role: Seeded NMF deconvolution of spatial transcriptomic spots
coverage_note: Separate original SPOTlight workflow remains missing. The paper reports version 1.0.3 and a >=10% predicted neutrophil spot rule; no implementation or biological reproduction credit.

name: BD Rhapsody analysis pipeline
role: Process Rhapsody sequencing files, align, quantify and filter cells
coverage_note: Separate original pipeline; source and license/runtime assessment remains open. P051 reports local 1.9.1 processing and another unversioned processing context. Hardware descriptions add no software use or implementation credit.
